quiz.question_id: Apa fungsi utama struct dalam Go menurut lesson ini?
quiz.question_en: According to this lesson, what is the main purpose of a struct in Go?
options_id: Menggantikan semua interface
Mengelompokkan field bernama dengan tipe berbeda untuk memodelkan data kustom
Menyimpan hanya data homogen seperti array
Memberikan inheritance seperti class OOP tradisional
options_en: To replace all interfaces
To group named fields of different types for modeling custom data
To store only homogeneous data like an array
To provide inheritance like a traditional OOP class

quiz.question_id: Apa tradeoff utama antara struct literal bernama field dan positional literal?
quiz.question_en: What is the main tradeoff between a named-field struct literal and a positional literal?
options_id: Positional literal lebih jelas karena menyebut nama field
Named-field literal lebih tahan terhadap kesalahan urutan, sedangkan positional bergantung pada urutan field yang tepat
Keduanya identik dan compiler menghapus semua perbedaan
Named-field literal hanya valid untuk struct anonim
options_en: A positional literal is clearer because it names the fields
A named-field literal is less error-prone about ordering, while a positional literal depends on the exact field order
They are identical and the compiler removes all differences
A named-field literal is only valid for anonymous structs

quiz.question_id: Jika `var p Person` dideklarasikan tanpa inisialisasi, apa zero value untuk field `Name string`?
quiz.question_en: If `var p Person` is declared without initialization, what is the zero value of the `Name string` field?
options_id: `nil`
`"zero"`
Undefined
options_en: `nil`
`"zero"`
Undefined

options_id: Field struct tidak bisa diubah setelah dibuat
Field diakses dan diubah dengan dot operator
Itu adalah method call terselubung
Email harus selalu diubah lewat pointer ke struct
options_en: Struct fields cannot be changed after creation
Fields are accessed and modified with the dot operator
It is a disguised method call
Email must always be changed through a pointer to the struct

quiz.question_id: Kapan anonymous struct paling masuk akal dipakai?
quiz.question_en: When is it most sensible to use an anonymous struct?
options_id: Saat tipe akan dipakai luas di banyak package
Saat butuh data sementara atau test cases tanpa mendefinisikan tipe bernama baru
Saat butuh inheritance
Saat ingin menghindari semua zero value
options_en: When the type will be widely reused across many packages
When you need temporary data or test cases without defining a new named type
When you need inheritance
When you want to avoid all zero values

quiz.question_id: Apa manfaat utama nested struct seperti `Person` yang memiliki field `Address Address`?
quiz.question_en: What is the main benefit of a nested struct such as `Person` having an `Address Address` field?
options_id: Mencegah akses ke field bagian dalam
Mengelompokkan sub-data terkait secara eksplisit di dalam model yang lebih besar
Mengubah `Address` menjadi interface secara otomatis
Membuat semua field menjadi private
options_en: It prevents access to the inner fields
It groups related sub-data explicitly inside a larger model
It automatically turns `Address` into an interface
It makes all fields private

quiz.question_id: Bagaimana cara mengakses kota dari `budi` pada example nested struct?
quiz.question_en: How do you access the city from `budi` in the nested struct example?
options_id: `budi.City`
`budi.Address.City`
`budi->Address->City`
`city(budi.Address)`
options_en: `budi.City`
`budi.Address.City`
`budi->Address->City`
`city(budi.Address)`

quiz.question_id: Kapan dua struct dapat dibandingkan dengan `==`?
quiz.question_en: When can two structs be compared with `==`?
options_id: Selalu, tanpa pengecualian
Hanya jika semua field bertipe comparable
Hanya jika struct punya method `Equal()`
Tidak pernah, struct harus dibandingkan manual
options_en: Always, with no exceptions
Only if all fields are of comparable types
Only if the struct has an `Equal()` method
Never, structs must be compared manually

quiz.question_id: Mengapa struct dengan field slice, map, atau func tidak bisa dibandingkan dengan `==` secara langsung?
quiz.question_en: Why can't a struct with slice, map, or func fields be directly compared with `==`?
options_id: Karena field-field itu bukan tipe comparable
Karena compiler tidak mendukung struct besar
Karena `==` hanya untuk pointer
Karena zero value field tersebut tidak diketahui
options_en: Because those fields are not comparable types
Because the compiler does not support large structs
Because `==` is only for pointers
Because the zero values of those fields are unknown

quiz.question_id: Pernyataan mana yang paling akurat tentang struct dibanding array/slice?
quiz.question_en: Which statement is most accurate about a struct compared with an array/slice?
options_id: Struct cocok untuk data heterogen bernama; array/slice untuk koleksi elemen homogen
Struct dan slice identik kecuali syntax
Struct hanya bisa berisi field string
Struct tidak bisa dinesting
options_en: A struct suits named heterogeneous data; arrays/slices suit homogeneous collections
Structs and slices are identical except for syntax
A struct can only contain string fields
A struct cannot be nested
